You write exact image specs for one family of the AI-table art replacement. Do not generate images yourself.

CONTEXT (shared):
- Project «AI-стол»: a Slavic dark-fantasy tabletop RPG (Russian folk-tale heroes) played on a big touch table, a TV and a GM tablet. Campaign «Чёрная вода у Мельничьего брода» (story id mill-ford).
- Owner order, 2026-11-04, verbatim: «экран тв отвратный ты че скинул хуйня и проверь все картинки нпс лица все должно быть перегенерировано нашим кодексом типо от старых генераций локальной модели не должно остаться ничего они стрем.»
  So all 72 images made by the old local model (manifest rows with "class": "generated", recipe.model "segmind/Segmind-Vega+segmind/Segmind-VegaRT") must be replaced, either by an EXISTING Codex asset that depicts the same thing, or by a NEW image from Codex built-in image generation (gpt-image-2) with the deck's Codex art as style references.
- VPS (read only for you): ssh orchestra-vps. Repo worktree /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp-rc. Files: provenance/art/manifest.json (asset rows: asset_id, kind, use, sha256, bytes, format, class, recipe), provenance/art/prompts.json (old prompts — describe the CONTENT the old image was meant to show), content/story/mill-ford-v1.json (beats, NPCs, texts), server/ai_table/domain/encounters.py and contracts/calibration/*.json (encounter grids), contracts/rules-bundle.json (abilities). Art store (images) /home/kesha/ai-table-evidence/DESIGN/store/<asset_id>.webp. ImageMagick 'identify'/'convert' exist on the VPS; no PIL anywhere.
- Hub style references (Codex art, approved deck): claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign/assets/gen/*.webp, prompts used for them in claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign/assets/gen/SOURCES.tsv and in the manifest recipe.prompt of class "generated-hosted" rows. Sizes: busts/portraits 1254x1254, scenes and map-ford 1536x1024, tokens and ab-* icons 512x512, all opaque (srgb, no alpha) except portrait-agafya (768x768, RGBA — the CEO wants it redone on a dark background).

FAMILY: faces-tokens​. Faces and tokens.
- The 6 hero portraits (portrait-guardian … portrait-voice): the Codex rows bust-<hero> have the same use {"portrait":"<hero>"}; verify the identity matches and mark action reuse with reuse_asset_id bust-<hero>.
- NPC portraits portrait-onisim (npc.onisim), portrait-karas (npc.karas), portrait-agafya (npc.agafya): action regenerate. Read who they are in the story JSON (look, age, role, mood; Онисим — the old miller; Евсей Карась — the cold salt-works steward; Агафья — the ferrywoman). The current Codex Agafya is /home/kesha/ai-table-evidence/DESIGN/store/portrait-agafya.webp on the VPS: copy it to claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-art-codex/refs/portrait-agafya-old.webp (scp; you may create claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-art-codex/refs/) and give it as an identity reference for her. Target 1254x1254, transparent false.
- Enemy tokens token-foreman (use [скрыто] — the senior sluice watchman), token-hand (token hand — a sluice worker/watchman with a boat hook), token-karas (token​ karas — Евсей Карась as a fighter): action regenerate. Read encounters.py and the story for what they are. Target 512x512 opaque.
